_comment: Golden retrieval-eval set: query -> acceptable expected pattern _keys (any-of). Categories: paraphrase (semantic recall, low lexical overlap), keyword (error-code/term lookup, BM25), concept (vague cross-project). Synced into the eval_queries collection and scored by scripts/eval_retrieval.py. Keep queries phrased the way a developer would actually type them mid-problem; never paste a pattern's problem_description verbatim.
